lines: Everything in or out of this city is written in that book. Everything.
Except when the seal says Foundation. Then it is EQUIPMENT, and left alone.
A boy in a green coat asked me the same thing. I told him more than I meant to.
Everything in or out of this city is written in that book. Everything.
Except when the seal says Foundation. Then it is written EQUIPMENT and left alone.

ef_gate_carter: Fourteen days up from Tideglass with a full load. Nine coming back light.
You want to know a city, look at what it sends out. We send out copper, and we send out kettles.
